terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using the Waylo platform.

sections.acceptanceBody: By accessing or using the Waylo platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not use the platform.
sections.accountBody: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of account credentials. You must provide accurate, current, and complete information when registering. Account sharing or identity misrepresentation is strictly prohibited.
sections.learnerBody: Learners are entitled to access learning content, personalized roadmaps, and skill assessments. All assessments and certification exams must be completed independently without third-party assistance. Dishonesty will result in revocation of Verified Skill badges and account suspension.
sections.companyBody: Partner companies may post jobs and access the Talent Pool according to their active subscription tier. Candidate data accessed through the Talent Pool may only be used for internal recruitment purposes and may not be distributed to third parties.
sections.billingBody: Subscription payments are processed securely through our official payment gateway (Midtrans). Subscription fees are non-refundable unless required by applicable law. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle.
sections.ipBody: All course materials, H5P interactive formats, graphics, logos, and platform code are protected by intellectual property and copyright laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Unauthorized duplication is prohibited.
sections.liabilityBody: Waylo strives to provide accurate career recommendations and skill verifications, but does not guarantee employment or specific hiring outcomes. Final hiring decisions rest entirely with employer organizations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Waylo's commitment to protecting your personal data in accordance with Law No. 27 of 2022 (UU PDP).

sections.lawBody: Waylo complies with Indonesian Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP). We act as a Personal Data Controller ensuring all data processing is carried out under lawful legal bases and with your explicit consent.
sections.dataCollectedBody: We collect identity data (name, email), professional profile data (headline, location, target career), learning progress, assessment scores, verified skill credentials, and encrypted transaction metadata.
sections.purposeBody: Data is used to personalize learning roadmaps, issue digital completion certificates, compute skill gap matrices against industry benchmarks, and connect you with mentors and relevant career opportunities.
sections.talentPoolBody: Pursuant to Article 20 of UU PDP, your candidate profile, assessment scores, and contact information are never disclosed to company recruiters in the Talent Pool without your explicit opt-in consent via your Profile settings. You may revoke consent at any time.
sections.securityBody: We implement end-to-end transport encryption (TLS 1.3), bcrypt password hashing, and strict role-based access control (RBAC) across our backend database infrastructure.
sections.rightsBody: As a data subject, you hold the right to access, rectify, obtain copies of, restrict processing of, and request deletion (right to erasure) of personal data stored in our systems.
sections.contactBody: If you have questions regarding personal data protection or wish to exercise your data subject rights, please contact our Data Protection Team at privacy@waylo.test.
